mapper.insert: insert into setmeal (name, category_id, price, status, description, image, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{status}, #{description}, #{image}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select id, name, category_id, price, status, description, image, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user from setmeal where id = #{id}
mapper.update:
update setmeal
name = #{name},
category_id = #{categoryId},
price = #{price},
status = #{status},
description = #{description},
image = #{image},
update_time = #{updateTime},
update_user = #{updateUser},
